title: Athlean X’s Science Workout 2025 - BroSplit(5 Day)
author: Pranay Shetty
desc:
Based on Jeff Cavaliere, the founder of ATHLEAN-X's  Perfect Science-Based Workout series for 2025.

Link to series - https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLRS2DE4P39EdzTqPZTL_uYvMZi7tichL0

This workout focuses on the Chest, Back, Legs, Triceps, Biceps, and Shoulder muscle groups, hitting each group once across 10 days of training in 2 weeks to effectively stimulate and grow each.

ex.note: This is just a primer exercise designed to get the rotator cuff warmed up before starting your chest workout.
After reaching form failure on each set, keep performing partial reps till complete failure.
This is a minimum of two sets.  After failure, you will then pull your elbows in to help lift the weight back up and then focus on the eccentrics while performing more reps till absolute failure.
1.5 rep Ladder.  Go down, half way up and then back down and hold for one second.  Then on the next rep hold for two seconds.  Keep adding a second on each rep.  Done to failure
Done to failure with partials till absolute failure.
This is a primer exercise designed to warm up your shoulders.
Keep elbows wide!  Third set optional.
Narrow Grip.  Perform to failure and then perform partials till full failure. Third set optional.
Focus on eccentrics (controlling weight up)!Optional third set.  Perform eccentric after failure  by rowing in and then Tricep pushdown and eccentric control back up with stretched arms.
1.5 reps (go down, half way up and back down) hold for a second after full rep.  This is a Ladder set so add a second to each rep.  Perform till failure.
Perform body weight pull ups first to failure.  Then step in bands and perform to failure and then beyond with partials to full failure.
Optional second set, primer set to warm up lower back.
Trap Bar Optional.  Perform warm up sets (8 reps at 40% working weight, 5 reps at 60% working weight and then 2 sets at 80% working weight, optional 4th warm up set 1 rep at 90% working weight).
Alternate Legs, do 10 reps each leg.
4 secs down and 4 secs up.  Perform to failure with partial reps performed to full failure. Third set optional.
Third set optional.
Perform both legs till failure.  Then half the weight and then use both legs to drop the weight, but only one leg to raise the weight focused on eccentric.  Alternate legs during eccentric raises.
For dumbbell perform single arm reps.  Barbell Optional.  Third set optional.
Perform straight arm till failure and then perform bent arm till failure.  After that perform partials till full failure.  Fourth set optional.
Optional Third Set
Optional third set.  Perform Eccentric after failure to full failure.
Performed with Dumbbells or Cable.  Optional third set.  Perform partials after failure to full failure.
Go till failure
Optional third set.  Perform to failure and the step away from your back support and perform to cheat curl with eccentric lower to full failure.
Optional third set.  Perform partials after failure to full failure.
Optional third set.  Perform each set  10-12 reps each arm and go to failure.
Rep 1 1 sec down, 1 sec up. Rep 2 2 sec down, 2 sec up.  Rep 3 3 sec down, 3 sec up.  Rep 4 4 sec down, 4 sec up. Rep 5 5 sec down, 5 sec up. Rep 6 5 sec down, 5 sec up. Rep 7 4 sec down, 4 sec up….
Primer sets.  Second set optional.
Perform to failure with partials reps performed to full failure.
Third set optional.
1.5 Rep Dip Ladder.  Perform to failure.
Prison Yard Style!
Primer Sets, second set optional.
Optional Chest Supported Barbell Row.  Third set optional.  Perform all sets to failure.
Perform to failure and then do partials till full failure.  Third set optional.
Perform to form failure. Third set optional.
1.5 Reps Ladder (Down, up half, down and hold for a second, up.  Then for next rep add a second to the hold for each rep performed).  One arm per set. Perform to failure.
Perform to failure, plus partials to full failure.
Primer sets.  Optional Second set.

Thirds set optional.

Perform to failure plus partials till full failure.  Third set optional.
